answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 36287 Country: India Title: I have pet cats. Sometimes they sit on the ja-namaz and crawl around us when we are praying Question: I have pet cats. Sometimes they sit on the ja-namaz and crawl around us when we are praying. Is it a matter of sin for us, since a human is not allowed to pass/walk from the front when we pray during namaz? Answer ID: 36287 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 237/237/M=1433) There is no sin if cats pass in front of you while you are offering salah. Animals are not bound by Shariah. But if you think that they would make the ja-namaz (prayer mat) dirty, and they would disturb if they crawl around you, hence it is better for you to offer salah in such a place free from their interference. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
